2. **`zzz_disruption.pth`** - A `.pth` file in the same directory that automatically imported `path_disrupt` when Python started, activating the disruption.

The fix was to remove both files:
- `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/path_disrupt.py`
- `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/zzz_disruption.pth`
